strategies.name: Pipelined reduce-scatter then all-gather chain
strategies.desc: Replace each all-reduce with a reduce-scatter followed by all-gather, allowing the scale/unscale operations to happen on smaller W×S/W chunks between the two primitives. Expected 16 collective dispatches (8 RS + 8 AG) but with smaller intermediate working sets and potential for better pipeline overlap. Trades more dispatches for reduced memory pressure and computation on smaller tensors.

strategies.name: Hierarchical two-level reduction with node-local aggregation
strategies.desc: Exploit multi-node structure by performing intra-node all-reduce followed by inter-node all-reduce at each stage, applying scale operations only at node boundaries. Expected 16 collective dispatches (8 stages × 2 levels) but with reduced cross-node bandwidth consumption. Optimizes for network topology by keeping most traffic local.

strategies.name: Batched multi-stage all-reduce with pre-computed scale tensors
strategies.desc: Pre-compute all scale and inverse-scale coefficient tensors, then batch adjacent all-reduce calls to exploit hardware collective offload pipelining. Expected 8 all-reduce dispatches but with overlapped preparation of scale tensors in device memory. Minimizes dispatch overhead by maximizing work-per-dispatch and pre-staging all coefficients.

strategies.name: Reduce-scatter accumulation with final all-gather broadcast
strategies.desc:
Perform 8 stages of reduce-scatter where each rank accumulates only its designated S-sized shard with progressive scaling, then single all-gather to broadcast final result. Expected 8 reduce-scatter + 1 all-gather (9 total dispatches). Minimizes redundant full-vector operations by having each rank process only 1/W of data until final broadcast.
